networks.name: kiln_row
networks.description: A marketplace of independent potters, glassmakers and weavers. The guide finds a piece and hands you to the maker's own assistant.
sample_queries: I want a stoneware mug under £30.
Can a studio make a custom dinner set?

peer_policy.note: Hands a shopper to a seller's own assistant only for that seller's pieces. Tidewater Studio is reached through its A2A Agent Card.
